rules: statement closure: types, and definition bodies of declarations in Spec/ and Challenge/; theorems other than the headlines not followed; auxiliary constants counted as their owner; nested ranges (constructors, fields) counted in the enclosing declaration; lines = distinct source lines of the declaration ranges, docstrings included

H1.what: profile certificate soundness, BGV and BFV

H2.what: default-mode decision soundness, BGV and BFV (soundness at the certificate's budget, decryption of every output, and the worst-case certificate)

H3.what: security: fresh-only game (BFV, BGV) and the game with evaluation on earlier results

H4.what: algorithm level: BEHZ multiplication meets its contract; MSB transfer

DEC.what: the four locked decision functions and everything they call

DEC2.what: the default-mode decision functions certify? and certifyBFV? and everything they call

H1+H3-S.what: H1 and H3 without the bodies of the profile decision functions
